stages.purpose: Map the request to outcomes, boundaries and open questions in this result's `summary`.
Inspect the repository and baseline tests; write the facts to HOME/environment.md and the baseline run to `evidence_refs`.
Resolve the consequential unknowns with evidence in RUN/notes/research.md; durable facts go to HOME/environment.md.
Define each requirement and its acceptance criteria as R-<n> in HOME/spec.md; ShipLoop derives this run's ID changes from the spec diff.
Map each requirement to the checks that prove it: harnesses and commands in HOME/environment.md, boundaries in HOME/architecture.md.
Plan dependencies and the queue: ordered `work_items`, `assumptions`, and structure decisions in HOME/architecture.md.
Ready the development and test environment; record readiness in HOME/environment.md and runner output in `evidence_refs`.
Plan this item's change: `criteria`, `steps`, `test_commands`; `expectations`, `paths`, `follows` in the result.
Specify this item's tests: one `test_cases` row per focused-command ID, with oracle, RED and GREEN. Write no test code.
Resolve each expectation that mismatched on the item base: fix it in WORKTREE or report revise with `failed_expectations`.
Make this step's change in WORKTREE; exit codes go to RUN/notes/<action>.md, uncovered behaviour to `not_covered`.
Write a test per quoted case, titled with its ID; make every recorded command pass in WORKTREE; fields go in the result.
Update the docs this change affects in WORKTREE from observed behaviour; no-change reasons go to RUN/notes/<action>.md.
Accept the item: confirm each criterion after the last edit, trace entry points; review the diff; notes in RUN/notes/<action>.md.
Close the item: update the knowledge home; the future queue in `work_items`; the reusable-skill decision in `skill`.
Author the system tests: catalog and integrated plan in `summary`, `system_commands`, unrunnable cases in `assumptions`.
Run the recorded system tests on the assembled candidate: end states in `summary`, command output in `evidence_refs`.
Assess the product against the request: each outcome's end state in `summary`, gaps in `unverified`, missing work as replan.
Plan the release without performing it: steps and rollback in `summary` and HOME/environment.md, `consumer_checks`, `consumer_entry`.
Confirm the candidate is release-ready without releasing: dry run and confirm commands once, results in `summary` and `evidence_refs`.
Perform the planned release; record its effect and the artifact's identity in `summary` and `evidence_refs`.
Observe the released result where consumers use it; outcomes in `summary` and `evidence_refs`, run lessons in `lessons`.
Confirm the release can be monitored, recovered and supported: evidence in `summary`, locators in HOME/environment.md.
Write the final handoff in `summary`: status per area with locators in `evidence_refs`, plus limits and open items.
